settings.title: System parameters
settings.description: Controls how long Management Console login sessions stay valid. Secrets and the initial admin password are never shown here.
settings.fields.env.hint: From REFRAQ_ENV (for example dev / staging / prod). Read-only; identifies which environment this API process is running in.
settings.fields.ttl.hint: After an admin signs in, the session expires after this many hours and requires a new login. Applies only to sign-ins after you save; sessions already open keep the expiry written at login. Allowed range: 1–168.
settings.fields.source.hint: Environment variable: using the baseline below. Runtime override: this page has temporarily replaced that baseline and takes precedence.
settings.fields.default.hint: From ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_HOURS — the default lifetime when no runtime override is set. Clearing the override restores this value.
settings.save.success: Login session lifetime updated (new sign-ins only)
settings.clear.success: Runtime override cleared; environment baseline restored
settings.hint.override: A runtime override lives only in this API process memory: it is not shared across replicas and is lost on restart. For a lasting change, set the environment variable and restart.
settings.validation.ttl: Lifetime must be an integer from 1 to 168 (hours)
